BASE = '{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}'

# Test 1: timeout=null on overwrite_payload
c = 'tc_null_' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
# Create collection first
r = requests.put(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}', json={"vectors": {"size": 4, "distance": "Cosine"}})
if r.status_code not in (200, 201):
    print(f'setup create failed: {r.status_code}')
    sys.exit(0)
time.sleep(0.5)

# Upsert a point first
r = requests.put(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}/points', json={"points": [{"id": 1, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4], "payload": {"key": "value"}}]})
time.sleep(0.3)

# Now test overwrite_payload with timeout=null
body = {
    "payload": {"key2": "value2"},
    "points": [1],
    "timeout": None
}
r = requests.put(f'{BASE}/collections/{c}/points/payload', json=body)
if r.status_code == 200:
    print(f'[DEFECT: ILLEGAL_SUCCESS] timeout=null accepted on overwrite_payload')
    sys.exit(1)
else:
    print(f'timeout=null correctly rejected: {r.status_code} {r.text[:200]}')
    sys.exit(0)
